states.name: engaged
states.description: User is actively following the rehabilitation interaction.

states.name: neutral
states.description: No obvious positive or negative state signal.

states.name: confused
states.description: User may not understand the instruction or task goal.

states.name: fatigued
states.description: User shows fatigue or decreasing interaction energy.

states.name: frustrated
states.description: User shows irritation or negative affect during the task.

states.name: refusing
states.description: User appears to refuse or withdraw consent for the current interaction.

states.name: pain_risk
states.description: User may be experiencing pain or physical discomfort; this is a safety cue, not a diagnosis.

states.name: low_attention
states.description: User attention is low or drifting away from the task.

states.name: needs_help
states.description: User appears to need assistance from the robot, teacher, therapist, or caregiver.
